$comment: For every jurisdiction the source watch covers: what auto-update can correct by itself ('automatic', each backed by a rule in autoupdate.json), what it only compares and reports ('report_only'), and what is left to a person and why. tests enforce that every income-tax or local-tax jurisdiction in data/ appears here and that every reference is real. 'No wage income tax and no local tax' jurisdictions (AK FL NH NV SD TN TX WY) are in scope.json's excluded list instead.
